messages:
Joelle (PM): Quick triage — after last week's launch of Search Suggest v1 we need clear rules to split next sprint between fixes vs enhancements. Proposed criteria: P0 = crash/data loss => immediate patch; P1 = functional regressions impacting >5% of requests or >=1 enterprise customer => top priority for next sprint; P2 = UX polish or perf under threshold => consider for enhancements backlog. Also propose a cutoff: any bug filed before 2025-11-01 23:59 UTC that meets P1/P0 goes into the week+0 patch; others get groomed into the enhancement wave.

Eli (Eng): agree with criteria. two notes: 1) we need a measurable metric for ">5%" — use error-rate increase in prod (alerts already set). 2) if fix requires model re-training or infra change it should be scoped out of the week+0 patch unless it's a P0.

Priya (Product): +1. Suggest adding customer-impact override: CS can escalate a single enterprise customer's issue to P1 even if % is small. @Lena please confirm.

Lena (CS): Confirmed — CS triage will flag customer escalations and tag them with customer-impact ticket. We'll include the ticket link in the bug description.

Maya (Design): For enhancements, let's require a mock or acceptance criteria in the ticket. No design -> no enhancement for this cycle. Keeps scope tight.

Rohit (SRE): Also call out rollback criteria in the patch plan. If latency >200ms 95p or error-rate regresses 3x baseline we roll back. Add canary at 5-10% before full rollout.

Joelle (PM): Good. Action items: Eli -> assess each P1 candidate for infra/model risk (due EOD); Maya -> list which enhancements have designs (due Tue); Lena -> compile customer escalations. We'll track in the patch board: https://notion.redwood.com/page/search-suggest-postlaunch

Eli (Eng): I'll start triaging. If a fix is <= 4 dev-days we try to include in patch; larger items move to enhancement backlog with ETA.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: hotfix/search-suggest-2025-11-02 at 10:00 UTC -> 10% traffic

Joelle (PM): We'll review final patch list in tomorrow's 10am sync. If anyone has blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
